base_rules.name: Placeholder Token Guard
base_rules.rule_text: All published marketing copy must be complete and free of unfinished placeholder tokens such as lorem ipsum, TODO markers, or bracketed insert prompts.
base_rules.rule_quote: unfinished placeholder tokens such as lorem ipsum, TODO markers, or bracketed insert prompts
base_rules.suggestion: Replace this placeholder with complete, relevant content.
base_rules.replacement: Please insert verified and relevant content here.

base_rules.name: Absolute Claim Verification
base_rules.rule_text: Marketing and product communications must avoid unsupported absolute guarantees such as 100% safe, secure, effective, or risk-free claims unless substantiated by verified evidence.
base_rules.rule_quote: avoid unsupported absolute guarantees such as 100% safe, secure, effective, or risk-free claims
base_rules.message: Potentially unsupported absolute claim. Verify before publication.
base_rules.suggestion: Avoid absolute guarantees unless supported by verifiable evidence.

rules.name: Restricted Phrase
rules.rule_text: Promotional copy must not promise permanent free access using phrases like free forever unless explicitly backed by a currently approved lifetime offer.
rules.rule_quote: must not promise permanent free access using phrases like free forever
rules.suggestion: Avoid promising permanent free access unless this is an approved offer.

rules.name: Unapproved Superlative
rules.rule_text: Brand communications must not use unsubstantiated superlatives such as best in the world; replace them with factual, verifiable product descriptions.
rules.rule_quote: must not use unsubstantiated superlatives such as best in the world
rules.message: Verify this superlative against brand guidelines.
rules.suggestion: Replace unsupported superlatives with a factual description.
rules.replacement: built to support business security and performance

rules.name: Banned Return Guarantee
rules.rule_text: Financial promotions must never use banned absolute return claims such as guaranteed percentage returns; replace with qualified phrasing like projected up to.
rules.rule_quote: never use banned absolute return claims such as guaranteed percentage returns
rules.suggestion: Replace absolute return guarantees with qualified wording: projected up to.

rules.name: Approved Brand Palette
rules.rule_text: All marketing banners and visual flyers must use the approved brand palette (#0F172A, #142C3B, #22A895, #E8F5F1, #F7F8F5, #FFFFFF) and must avoid unapproved dominant background colours such as #1E40AF.
rules.message: Unapproved dominant colour detected in visual asset (VIS-02).
rules.suggestion: Update banner colours to match the approved brand palette (#0F172A / #22A895).

rules.name: Deprecated Legacy Logo
rules.rule_text: Creative assets must display only the current brand mark; deprecated 2024 legacy logos are prohibited in published banners and flyers.
rules.rule_quote: deprecated 2024 legacy logos are prohibited in published banners and flyers
rules.message: Deprecated 2024 logo detected in visual asset (VIS-05).
rules.suggestion: Replace the deprecated 2024 logo mark with the current approved BrandGuard/Acme mark.
